about.title: About us
about.description: The masterclasses are one-day workshops developed by the Netzwerk Teilchenwelt for students, providing an overview of particle physics and data analysis, as well as initial insights into research. This software is based on the event display program of the CMS experiment at CERN. It is used in the masterclasses to visualize detector recordings of proton-proton collisions. The goal of the masterclass is to determine the mass of the Z and Higgs bosons.
about.sponsors: This project was made possible by the following institutions:
about.github: The source code is available on GitHub:
about.origin: This software is a version of the iSpy WebGL event display for the CMS experiment at CERN, adapted for students. The original version was developed by F. Ali, L. Barnard, M. Hategan, S. Lee, C. Logrén, T. McCauley, P. Nguyen, and M. Saunby.
about.cms-interactive: Interactive view of the CMS detector, illustrating the traces and signatures left by different types of particles.
about.event-display: The original event display program for the CMS experiment at CERN, allowing detailed exploration of particle collision events.

sel-fields.selMuons: Number of Muons required. This selection is only considered, when the checkbox is checked. If the pT constraint is also provided, only muons passing this selection are counted.
sel-fields.selElectrons: Number of Electrons required. This selection is only considered, when the checkbox is checked. If the pT constraint is also provided, only electrons passing this selection are counted.
sel-fields.selPhotons: Number of photons required. This selection is only considered, when the checkbox is checked.
sel-fields.charge: Required sign of the charge sum of all selected leptons
sel-fields.pt: Minimum p<sub>T</sub> required for the leptons
sel-fields.maxMETs: Maximum MET required. This selection is only considered, when the checkbox is checked.
sel-fields.nSelected: Total Number of events passing the selection within the loaded file.
sel-fields.firstSelected: Indices of the first 5 events passing the selection
